title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the diff door refuses a bare two-holder name and compares one holder by ?package=
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Fixes #33308

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/` names the diff door, and the docs that do (`content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`, `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`) name the route without teaching how a name two packages hold is addressed, so no sentence there turns false; the generated API reference (`content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`) carries the new `DiffMetaItemRequest` with its `packageId`.

Declaration note: the claim (6895872289) first read `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, amended on the card (6898947511). Beside `Metadata-protocol: added` that pair is a `contradiction` in `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (`added-under-no`, exit 1), and this PR widens a published request (the new `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema`, and the door now takes `?package=`), so the lines above are #33193's (`yes (narrowing)` + `added`), the precedent this card mirrors. Measured both ways under Verification.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同名流程等按包存储的条目由两个包各持一份时，版本对比（diff）不再把一家的版本和另一家的版本当成同一条记录来比；不带包的对比在 History 和回滚已拒绝的地方同样返回 409 并列出各家，带 `?package=` 只比较那一家的版本（默认的“当前版本”也取那一家的行）。非按包存储的类型带 `?package=` 返回 400。spec 新增 `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema` 声明这个接口的请求。
- 为什么改：实测 main 上不带包的 `GET /meta/flow/NAME/diff` 返回 200，把 beta 的 v2 和 alpha 的 v3 比成“同一条记录的修改”，管理员据此判断回滚会恢复什么，会选错。
- 风险与回滚：只有“两家同时持有同名”时行为才变（原来 200，现在 409）；只有一家持有时不带包的对比与 main 完全一致。直接 revert 本 PR 即可，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`（`diffMetaItem` 接入 `historySlotOf`，默认 to/from 取本槽）、`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`（diff 门接 `?package=`）、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/history-diff-two-holders-33308.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/history-diff-two-holders-33308.dogfood.test.ts`，9 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（合入前需一次契约档复核）。

## What changes

**The rule is #33193's, not a second one.** `diffMetaItem` (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`) asks `historySlotOf` (`protocol-history-slots.ts`, unchanged) which row slot it addresses, exactly as `historyMetaItem` and `rollbackMetaItem` do:

- **Bare**, a by-package name two or more row slots hold, or one the bare plain read refuses (`resolveItem`, ADR-0150 D5), is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder (`details.candidates`) before any version is read: the default range and a named one alike. A name one slot holds diffs bare exactly as on `main`.
- **`?package=P`** compares P's slot only: the history rows are filtered by the same predicate the history door reads (`isVersionOf`, now exported from `sys-metadata-repository.ts`), so the default `from` side is P's nearest earlier differing version and the default `to` side is P's own active row (bound to P, or the package-less row for the environment's slot), never the name's first active row. A named version another holder owns, or one attributed to no package while two hold the name, is refused `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND` saying whose it is (`versionOfAnotherSlotError`, one sentence shared with the rollback door: "Nothing was compared." / "Nothing was restored.").
- **Every other type**: `?package=` is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (`param: package`) by the protocol (`refusePackageSelectorOutsideSlottedTypes`), never accepted and dropped.

**Door** (`GET /meta/:type/:name/diff`): `package` joins `META_ITEM_DIFF_PARAMS` and the door's repeat guard, is read through `historyPackageSelector` / `metaItemPackageBinding` as the history door reads it (`all` and empty name no package), and the refusal renders `details.candidates` (`packageScopedCandidates`). The request is compiled against the new declaration (`TransportScopedMetaRequest` of `DiffMetaItemRequest`), and both bounds are read through `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema.shape.fromVersion` / `toVersion` (`z.number().int()`, the same whole number `UNDECLARED_WHOLE_NUMBER_PARAM` read: no bound is refused that was accepted before).

**Spec**: `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema` (`type`, `name`, `fromVersion`, `toVersion`, `packageId` with the history doors' `HISTORY_PACKAGE_SELECTOR_DESCRIPTION`), its `DiffMetaItemRequest` / `DiffMetaItemRequestParsed` types, and the regenerated `api-surface`, `authorable-surface`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins`, `json-schema.manifest`, reference docs and strictness-ledger count. **`protocol.ts`**: only the `diffMetaItem` request type (`packageId?: string`) and its docblock (`@throws` for the 409, the cross-slot 404 and the 400), edited after #33898 merged.

**Console**: no `ui/` file changes. `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `MetadataClient.diff()` calls the door but nothing in `ui/` calls `diff()` (the `engine.layers.diff` tab is the Layers view, not this door), so there is no diff view to name the package in. See Acceptance notes.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/history-diff-two-holders-33308.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 9 cases, its own showcase boot with two `AppPlugin` holders and their `.custom` pairs): bare two-holder 409 with candidates (default range and named), their order and `kind` pinned at the wire; a package that neither holds nor ships the name 409 naming the holders; the environment's slot addressed through a package (the package-less row's versions alone, its own active row the `to` side, beside a bound row listed first); a name two packages ship one customized 409 as the bare read, `?package=` default range and named range inside the slot, another holder's version and an unattributed one 404, CONTROL one-holder bare (and `?package=` of its holder answers the same), CONTROL M1 environment versions, `?package=` on `view` 400 with the protocol's reason.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-history-slots.33308.test.ts` (new, 10 cases): the facet against a fake host, each arm alone; the bare refusal and the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal read no table; the environment's slot addressed through a package takes the package-less row as its `to` side when a bound row is listed first.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-package-selector.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` for the diff door in the family's existing harness (AGENTS.md, ruling record 6583487846): PRESERVATION under both bound spellings, CONTROL `all`/empty, REFUSAL repeated `?package=`, 409 candidates, 400 through the real protocol. `rest-server-meta-door-closed-sets.test.ts`: the measured-set pin takes `package`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` for `DiffMetaItemRequestSchema` beside the rollback request's.

<details><summary>Before the fix (H1 measured on this boot, pre-fix runtime): 6 of 7 red</summary>

```
× the bare diff of the two-holder name is refused 409 …
  {"fromVersion":2,"toVersion":3,"changed":[{"path":"label","from":"com.qa.diff33308.beta.custom r1","to":"com.qa.diff33308.alpha.custom r2"}]}: expected 200 to be 409
× a name two packages ship, one customized, is refused bare … expected 200 to be 409
× ?package= diffs that holder's versions alone … "The \"package\" query parameter is not supported by this endpoint. … Supported parameters: from, fromVersion, to, toVersion.": expected 400 to be 200
× ?package= refuses another holder's version … expected 400 to be 404
× CONTROL: a name one holder holds … (the `?package=` half: unknown parameter)
× ?package= on a type not stored per package … expected '{"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR",…' to contain 'not stored per package'
Tests  6 failed | 1 passed (7)
```

The bare default range alone answered alpha's v3 against beta's v2: the cross-holder diff the card measured, without even naming a version.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` anchor x1 → x0 and blob change proved, package rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` exit 0 on the marker, dogfood file run, restore to HEAD proved by blob and empty `git diff HEAD`, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0)</summary>

| Leg | Mutation (forbidden behaviour put back) | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `diffMetaItem` skips `historySlotOf` when no package is named (`__ablate33308_A1`) | 2 of 7: `the bare diff of the two-holder name is refused 409…`: `{"fromVersion":2,"toVersion":3,…"from":"…beta.custom r1","to":"…alpha.custom r2"} expected 200 to be 409`; `a name two packages ship, one customized…`: `expected 200 to be 409` |
| A2 | another slot's history row accepted (`isVersionOf` filter bypassed, `__ablate33308_A2`) | 2 of 7: `?package= diffs that holder's versions alone…`: `expected [ 2, 3 ] to deeply equal [ 1, 3 ]`; `?package= refuses another holder's version…`: `{"fromVersion":2,"toVersion":1,…} expected 200 to be 404` |
| A3 | the door accepts `?package=` and drops it (`__ablate33308_A3`, rest) | 3 of 7: the two `?package=` cases `expected 409 to be 200` / `expected 409 to be 404`; `?package= on a type not stored per package…`: `{"type":"view",…"fromVersion":null,"toVersion":null,…} expected 200 to be 400` |
| A4 | a package that neither holds nor ships the name answered an empty slot instead of the refusal (`__ablate33308_A4`) | dogfood 1 of 9: `a package that neither holds nor ships the name is refused 409…`: `{"type":"flow",…"fromVersion":null,"toVersion":null,…} expected 200 to be 409`; facet 1 of 10: `expected null to be an instance of PackageScopedNameRefusedError` |
| A5 | the active-row match never takes the package-less row (`__ablate33308_A5`) | dogfood 1 of 9 and facet 1 of 10, the environment's-slot case: `expected [ null, null ] to deeply equal [ 1, 2 ]`. The first try of this leg was refused by `ablation-replace.mjs` as a no-op (the replacement contained the anchor, `anchor count moved 1 -> 1`), so it was rerun with an anchor-free replacement |
| A6 | the holders listed in reverse order (`__ablate33308_A6`, `protocol-history-slots.ts`) | dogfood 3 of 9: the two-holder bare case, the non-holder case and the environment's-slot case, e.g. `expected [ { kind: 'environment' }, …(1) ] to deeply equal [ { kind: 'package', …(1) }, …(1) ]`; facet 3 of 10 |

After the last leg of each round: preflight `--absent` exit 0, tree clean. At `8ed07410cd` after A4 to A6: the dogfood file 9/9, the facet file and `protocol-history-slots` tests 25/25.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Console client, not called**: `MetadataClient.diff()` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`) takes no `packageId`; no `ui/` code calls it today, so nothing user-facing turns wrong, but a consumer of `@object-ui/data-objectstack` calling it on a two-holder name now gets the `409` with no way to name the holder. The SDK's `client.meta.diffItem` (`packages/client/src/index.ts`) sends only `from` and `to` as well, so an SDK caller's FROM / TO remedy is a raw request (the changeset says so). The client half of both is decided not planned: #33310, which names `meta.diffItem`, was closed as not planned on 2026-11-15 (record 6897313072) and reopens on need. It is not a pending follow-up of this PR.
- **A `doc` name two packages hold, at this door**: the changeset's `400` on `package` for a type not stored per package does not describe a `doc` name two enabled packages hold. That request is refused `409` with or without `?package=`, as the doc reads are today. The remedy is #34190 (open), not this PR.
- **Out-of-surface file, and why**: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` (not on the claim's File surface): `isVersionOf` is exported (the order names that predicate as the one to reuse; it was module-private), and the rollback's cross-slot `404` sentence moved into `versionOfAnotherSlotError` so both doors say it once. The rollback's message is unchanged (the same sentence, with "Nothing was restored." passed as the outcome).
- **Test placement**: the dogfood and metadata-protocol pins are new card-named files (the dogfood harness is `showcase-boot.ts`, shared by every file; the facet pin has its own fake host); the REST and spec pins are top-level `describe`s in the family's existing harness files, per AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846).
- **Rulings on the surface, kept**: `meta-item-history-routes.ts` 5865708652 (letter B), 5856774816, 6787890900; `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` #8833 maintainer ruling (no `historyUnavailable` key), commit 75e66fc8e Option B (diff raw, redact emitted), #20378 / #20451 retriage answers (the from-side walk by this diff's own equality, now inside the slot). No ruling, `maintainer` or `⛔` line is edited or removed; one `⛔` comment added (never another holder's version compared).
